algebra.step_1: sigma_anchor = cross-fold SD of a single-predictor per-fold LEVEL IC, READ from a committed artifact
algebra.step_2: SE(mean fold IC) = sigma_anchor / sqrt(k) * sqrt(1 + 2*sum_{l=1}^{k-1}(1-l/k)*rho_f^l)
algebra.step_3: MDE (one test) = 2.8 * SE; MDE (Holm worst case over n tests) = (z_(1-0.05/(2n)) + z_0.80) * SE
algebra.step_4: equivalence margin Delta = smallest rung of [0.03, 0.04, 0.05] with SE <= Delta/2.487; none -> UNPOWERED
algebra.why_not_the_h2_delta_anchor: census_e2 §2 anchors a DELTA between two fitted blocks sharing the numeric features (H2 within-fold bootstrap SD 0.1149 at n_dd 39.5). A level IC of one family has no shared component to cancel; its cross-fold dispersion is the anchor's, not the delta's.
caveats: Every MDE is a LOWER bound: folds are not independent (overlapping 63-session windows, common regimes). The AR(1) rho is an assumption at 0.3; E2 measured the fold-delta lag-1 autocorrelation at -0.042 (results_head1.json .margin.measured_lag1_autocorrelation) -- for a DELTA, not a level.
The anchors are single-predictor ICs. A 4-family equal-weight composite may be less dispersed per fold; no measurement of that exists before the run, so no smaller anchor is claimed.
The t-correction at k=33 (t_.975(32)+t_.80(32) = 2.890 vs 2.8) is NOT applied, matching census_e2.

The two E2 anchors were measured at frame B's per-fold size (n_dd 135.79); the *_n_adjusted_to_this_frame rows swap the 1/(n-1) sampling component to each frame's own n_dd (red-team S11). The H1 anchors were measured at 80-97 events per quarter, close to frame A's 92.5, and are not adjusted.

section_4b_survivorship_price_censoring.direction_by_family_statement: Dead-name exclusion removes the worst outcomes from the scored set. Its direction differs by family: dropping dead high-volatility / low-momentum losers biases the low_volatility and momentum ICs DOWN (their worst confirming cases are missing); dropping dead distressed high-book-to-market names biases the value IC UP (its worst disconfirming cases are missing); profitability is ambiguous. The cause of the missing prices is not separately measured, so none of this is called delisting (G3 §11).
